placeholder_text: This screen is still being built.
error_network: No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
error_timeout: The connection took too long. Try again.
error_unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
error_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error_validation: Some details are not valid. Check them and try again.
error_conflict: This request can't be completed right now.
error_server: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a little while.
login_subheading: Log in to see how much you have left
register_subheading: Just three things and you're in.
validation_email_taken: An account with this email already exists
register_next_steps_note: Next, we'll ask about your salary and fixed commitments.
password_strength_short: Too short · use at least 8 characters
password_strength_weak: Weak · add numbers or capital letters
onboarding_income_lead: Every calculation runs on this number.
onboarding_payday_label: Which day of the month are you paid?
onboarding_cycle_explain: Your current cycle runs from {start} to {end} · {days}. Payday sets the cycle, not the first of the month.
validation_salary_invalid: Enter your salary in numbers · e.g. 10000
onboarding_obligations_lead: What you pay every month. These amounts are set aside from your salary on the first day of the cycle, so the number you see is real.
onboarding_variable_tip: Bills that change, like electricity? Add them as {variable} with an estimate, and we adjust when the bill arrives.
obligation_kind_fixed_hint: Same amount every month · rent, internet, installment
obligation_kind_periodic_hint: Paid once every period · insurance, licence, school fees
obligation_variable_hint: We set this aside, adjust it when the bill arrives, and suggest an estimate from your last 3 bills.
obligation_periodic_hint: We set aside a part every month so the amount is ready when it is due.
onboarding_safety_lead: Two numbers that protect you at the end of the month.
safety_min_hint: What is left should not drop below this. We suggest {percent} of your salary: {amount}. The app works out a daily allowance so you finish the cycle above it.
safety_savings_hint: Set aside at the start of the cycle like a commitment. Leave it at zero if you are not ready yet.
safety_spent_label: How much have you spent since {date}?
safety_spent_hint: You are starting mid-cycle. Past daily spending (excluding commitments) is recorded as one amount so what is left stays accurate.
validation_amount_or_zero: Enter a valid number or zero
validation_amount_or_empty: Enter a valid number or leave it empty
onboarding_summary_lead: This is the plan the app will follow this cycle.
summary_daily_caption: and finish the cycle above your minimum
summary_over_income: Commitments, savings and your minimum are more than your income. Go back and lower savings or the minimum, or continue and adjust them later in settings.
summary_formula: Daily allowance = (available to spend − minimum − spent) ÷ days left.
